title: 品牌活动怎样让创作者愿意分享，也带来生意？
topic: 向营销团队汇报活动设计、内容传播和商业转化

source.title: How Unilever made House of Fresh™ creator-led and culturally unmissable
source.context: House of Fresh 于 2026 年世界杯期间举办；本课引用的是 Unilever 2026-09-03 报道时公布的累计触达与内容数据。
paragraphs: Reflecting Unilever’s wider strategy of moving from a one-to-many broadcast marketing model to a many-to-many social-first marketing approach, House of Fresh™ (Casa Fresh in Mexico) brought our brands together with creators and communities, driving engagement, advocacy and awareness at scale when the world was watching. It was the largest in-person influencer event in Unilever’s history.

We also wanted to connect content to commerce and product discovery, so Amazon partner content creators joined us at House of Fresh™, sharing shoppable content to promote exclusive limited-edition products. Unilever Personal Care and Amazon had a seamless pathway from content to conversion, turning cultural participation from commerce to cart. Creator commerce content delivered 5x greater reach than traditional brand advertising.

We’re still counting, but so far we’ve achieved reach of 2.5 billion, including PR and social coverage. House of Fresh™ sparked 6,000 pieces of content – meaning many of our guests posted more than once about their experience. The feedback from creators has been incredible.
translations: House of Fresh 体现了联合利华从单向的大众传播，转向多对多、以社交媒体为先的营销方式。它把品牌、创作者和社群带到一起，在全球关注赛事时推动互动、品牌倡导和认知度。
团队还希望把内容连接到商业转化。创作者在活动中分享可购买的内容，联合利华个人护理与亚马逊之间建立了从内容到转化的顺畅路径。这类创作者电商内容的触达量是传统品牌广告的 5 倍。
活动目前获得 25 亿次触达（包括公关和社交媒体传播），产生了 6,000 条内容。
fullTextParagraphs: More than 2,100 creators and sports legends visited Unilever Personal Care’s House of Fresh™ experiences in Mexico City, New York and Miami.
The creator-led marketing events sparked 6,000 pieces of content, with reach of 2.5 billion (and counting), and a top engagement rate of 16% – more than triple industry standards.
House of Fresh™ was designed to give creators countless opportunities to capture and share content, with our brands unmissably present throughout.
Sarah Potter, Influencer & Media Director for Unilever Personal Care
Sarah, how would you describe House of Fresh™?

House of Fresh™ was a creator-led experience in Mexico City, New York and Miami hosted by Unilever Personal Care during the FIFA World Cup 2026™. We set out to design a space that could help us turn the scale of the tournament into thousands of pieces of culturally relevant, socially native brand stories – and I’m very happy to say, we succeeded.

Reflecting Unilever’s wider strategy of moving from a one-to-many broadcast marketing model to a many-to-many social-first marketing approach, House of Fresh™ (Casa Fresh in Mexico) brought our brands together with creators and communities, driving engagement, advocacy and awareness at scale when the world was watching. It was the largest in-person influencer event in Unilever’s history.
What happened inside House of Fresh™ and who was there?

We wanted to give our guests unlimited opportunities to capture shareable moments, so House of Fresh™ was a content engine by design. People could create personalised Panini-inspired football stickers, custom jerseys and charm bracelets. They met football stars and played on our LED pitch. Even the refreshments were chosen to look great in social content, and the lighting throughout was carefully planned for filming and photography on smartphones.

Our brands were visible everywhere, not just the products on display, but also through events that brand teams tailored to their own communities and authentic brand messaging, so they naturally became part of the stories that creators shared.

Rexona hosted The New York Sweat Club, where guests could enjoy immersive gaming and compete in five-a-side games for a chance to win match tickets. Dove welcomed creators to its Confidence Arcade, where the brand shared its mission to keep girls confident in sports, and invited them to learn choreography and hear from body confidence experts. Dove Men+Care celebrated game-day rituals, and Axe invited influencers to create their own fragrances with a scent expert.

We were joined by more than 2,100 creators and influencers and several came back for repeat visits. Some of our VIP guests had millions of followers – such as sports legends Roberto Carlos, Daniel Sturridge and Marshawn Lynch. Some were nano creators with much smaller, ultra-engaged communities.
House of Fresh™ represented a shift toward creator-led marketing during a major sporting event. What were your goals?

Unilever being the Official Personal Care Sponsor of the FIFA World Cup 2026™ presented us with an opportunity for our brands to drive demand with an unmissable experience that felt part of football culture.

We wanted our brands to be talked about and our aim was to drive volume, variety and velocity of content. To do that we knew we had to come up with a creative, socially led and culturally salient experience that could compete outside our own categories. Something just as good – or even better – than the event’s other sponsors.

We put the experience and creator audiences first and our product messages second. It was about building brand desire, not just sponsorship awareness, and connecting our brands with the emotions, the rituals and the cultural moments around football.
What kind of content did creators produce after visiting House of Fresh™, and how did you balance giving them creative freedom while maintaining brand objectives?
It’s been a very broad mix from talent-led content and match coverage to posts where creators documented their visit to House of Fresh™ or were building hype for the FIFA World Cup 2026™ experience.
We didn’t ask all our guests to tag our brands. It was clear from the footage they shot that Unilever brands were showing up – we made sure they were unmissably present without it feeling forced.
The vast majority of content was completely organic, and we found that people started capturing the spaces the moment they walked in, some sharing live from the events.

We also wanted to connect content to commerce and product discovery, so Amazon partner content creators joined us at House of Fresh™, sharing shoppable content to promote exclusive limited-edition products. Unilever Personal Care and Amazon had a seamless pathway from content to conversion, turning cultural participation from commerce to cart. Creator commerce content delivered 5x greater reach than traditional brand advertising.
What are some of the stand-out results from House of Fresh™?

We’re still counting, but so far we’ve achieved reach of 2.5 billion, including PR and social coverage. House of Fresh™ sparked 6,000 pieces of content – meaning many of our guests posted more than once about their experience. The feedback from creators has been incredible.

We’re also thrilled that the content has performed so well, with a top engagement rate of 16% versus the industry standard of 5%. It’s shown us that brand visibility doesn’t require scripts and constant mentions.
Unilever is sponsoring the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027. How will you apply what you learned from House of Fresh™ to that partnership?

I can’t give too much away but ahead of next year we’re codifying House of Fresh™ to become a cultural platform for our brands. We’re looking at the ecosystem we can create to land our brands in culture through brilliant content that drives Desire at Scale.

It’s about shifting from a successful activation to a scalable marketing opportunity, and that’s something that we’ll apply not just in our football sponsorships, but in campaigns across Unilever into the future.
Frequently asked questions
What is House of Fresh™ and why did Unilever create it?

House of Fresh™ was Unilever Personal Care’s creator-led marketing activation during the FIFA World Cup 2026™, hosted in Mexico City, New York and Miami. Unilever designed the event as part of its shift from traditional broadcast marketing to a many-to-many social-first approach, reaching the tournament’s massive audience through thousands of culturally relevant brand stories from influencers and creators.
What makes House of Fresh™ different from other influencer events?

House of Fresh™ prioritised organic content over scripted brand mentions, proving that brand visibility is less about constant product call-outs and more about distinctive branding and relevance. The activation competed for share of voice outside Unilever’s Personal Care categories by creating shareable experiences as compelling as other FIFA World Cup 2026™ sponsors. It focused on building brand desire through cultural relevance and emotional connections to football.
How does House of Fresh™ support Unilever’s FIFA World Cup 2026™ sponsorship?

More than 6 billion people watched the FIFA World Cup 2026™ tournament. House of Fresh™ helped engage this vast global audience through culturally relevant brand stories, by engaging with 2,100+ influencers who captured and shared content from the events. Content from the three House of Fresh™ pop-ups in Mexico City, New York and Miami has achieved reach of 2.5 billion and counting.

notes.meaning: 多对多、以社交为先的营销方式
notes.explain: 这里强调让品牌、创作者和社群共同参与传播，不再只由品牌向大量受众单向发布。
notes.example: We are moving to a social-first approach for the launch.

notes.phrase: a seamless pathway from content to conversion
notes.meaning: 从内容到转化的顺畅路径
notes.explain: pathway 指一连串步骤；这里是观众看见内容后，可以直接找到商品并购买。
notes.example: The new product page creates a pathway from discovery to purchase.

notes.phrase: a top engagement rate of 16% versus the industry standard of 5%
notes.meaning: 最高互动率为 16%，行业标准为 5%
notes.explain: 报告这类指标时要同时说明比较对象；触达量和互动率代表不同结果。
notes.example: Our top engagement rate was 8% versus a 4% benchmark.

scenario.title: 复盘新品创作者活动
english: A home-appliance brand invited creators to a hands-on launch event and let them film in their own style.
A retail partner added shoppable links so viewers could move from a video to the product page.
Write a short update with the content results: 1,800 posts and 12 million views; report views separately from purchases.
chinese: 一个家电品牌邀请创作者参加新品体验活动，并允许他们按自己的风格拍摄。
零售合作方加入了可购买链接，让观众能从视频直接进入商品页。
写一条简短复盘，报告内容结果：1,800 条帖子、1,200 万次观看；把观看量和购买量分开。

firstAttempt.prompt: 请依据 Unilever 2026 年 9 月 3 日关于 House of Fresh 的报道，向营销团队写三句话：说明活动的社交传播方式、内容如何连接销售，以及截至报道发布时取得的结果。
firstAttempt.sample: House of Fresh brought brands, creators and communities together through a social-first experience. Amazon creators shared shoppable content, creating a path from discovery to purchase; creator commerce content reached five times more people than traditional brand ads. As of the September 3, 2026 report, the event had generated 6,000 pieces of content and reached 2.5 billion people through PR and social coverage.
firstAttempt.rationale: 把活动设计、销售路径和截至报道日期的可量化传播结果连起来，并区分触达与销售。
